facts.fact: Matty 又给 Emily 递了一杯酒，坐到她另一侧、把 JJ 隔开。
facts.anchor: Matty handed Emily another drink. Seated himself on the other side of her to JJ.

facts.fact: 他盘算她不能太醉，只要醉到刚好。
facts.anchor: She shouldn’t be too drunk, just drunk enough.

facts.fact: Emily 不耐烦地打断寒暄，问今晚谁去钓人。
facts.anchor: ‘Right then,’ said Emily, quickly and visibly bored with the niceties, ‘who’s on the pull tonight?’

facts.fact: Emily 随口拿 JJ 的名字开玩笑后，Alice 满脸怒容、JJ 很紧张。
facts.anchor: Alice still looked furious and JJ pretty tense after Emily’s careless remark about his name.

facts.fact: Emily 对满屋人宣布要坦白一件事：她真的在恋爱。
facts.anchor: ‘Listen,’ she said to the room at large, ‘I’ll confess something if you want. I’m actually in love.’

facts.fact: Emily 说对象是 Gareth，自己笑了，但满屋没人跟着笑。
facts.anchor: ‘Yes, it’s Gareth.’ Emily laughed, though no one else was laughing.

facts.fact: JJ 又给她倒酒，她举杯到嘴边时 Matty 轻轻按住她的手。
facts.anchor: JJ refilled her glass but Matty placed a gentle hand on hers as she brought it to her lips.

facts.fact: 他想象抱她回家、放上床，直接躺到她身边。
facts.anchor: Carry her home, put her to bed and climb right in beside her.
